Hi all,

Thanks for the quick sync earlier — follow-up with a concrete ask. We have the EdgeWorks co-sell demo scheduled for the listing preflight week (AWS requested a rehearsal window on the 8th). There are two constraints: (1) the primary SI lead (EdgeWorks) needs a longer deep-dive segment, and (2) AWS Marketplace preflight requires a separate 30–45m run-through with the platform team.

Proposal: I attached a first-pass ownership matrix (ops_matrix_v1.xlsx) and propose we reserve two contiguous blocks next week:
- Block A (customer-facing demo): 45m — Redwood + EdgeWorks present (product + SI deep-dive)
- Block B (marketplace preflight / platform): 30–45m — Redwood platform + AWS Marketplace rep

Questions / asks:
- Please confirm who will own each demo segment (presenter names) and who will be backup host for regional fallbacks (APAC / EMEA).
- Vanessa — can you confirm your calendar for morning slots (PST) on 7/7–7/9?
- Marcus / Karthik — I'll need a lean run-of-show (5–7 bullet steps) and call lead assignments before EOD Friday so we can share with EdgeWorks and AWS.

If we can't find contiguous windows, we should consider a staggered rehearsal (EdgeWorks does an earlier deep-dive, platform run-through follows).

Thanks — I'll update the Drive link once we lock times.

Best,
Olga
Director, Partner Ops
Redwood Inference
